bullets.title: NVDA: Rubin delay + neocloud stress = Hedgeye removes long; China orders constrained
bullets.body: Hedgeye removed their NVDA long on Rubin mass production delay pushed to Q2 2027 (from expected late Q4/Q1). Separately, ByteDance/Alibaba/Tencent placed ~$35B in NVDA RTX PRO 5500 orders but NVDA can only fulfill 5-10% due to US export controls (max 3M cards globally vs 6M+ ordered). Neocloud financing stress (rising yields, CRWV down 67% from peak) expected to temper AI system purchases; Wolfe also removed NVDA from its Alpha List noting investor expectations have caught up to guidance.

bullets.title: CRM acquires BRZE for $47.50/sh ($5.66B); sympathy lifts HUBS, INTU, NOW
bullets.body: Salesforce entering definitive agreement to acquire Braze for $47.50/share cash (~$5.66B enterprise value), expected to close in Salesforce FY28 with no change to FY27 guidance. CRM fell 3.1% pre-market on the deal; HUBS, INTU, and NOW rallied 4.1%, 2.1%, and 1.7% respectively on M&A read-through.

bullets.title: MSFT Q1 preview: Azure needs +46-47% beat-and-raise after +37% stock run
bullets.body: JPM and Piper both flag MSFT as needing a clear beat-and-raise: Azure consensus at +45% Y/Y with buy-side at +46-47%, M365 Commercial Cloud guide raised to +17% vs ~+18% expectations. MSFT guiding $210B capex for FY27 vs Street ~$190B; investor FY27 EPS expectations at $20.50-$22.00 vs Street $20. Piper names MSFT top pick citing strong 3Q partner checks; Hedgeye Risk Range keeps MSFT in bullish trend.

bullets.title: NFLX: Firing content chiefs, slipping engagement — into earnings tonight
bullets.body: Netflix fired film chief Dan Lin and content chief Bela Bajaria; Co-CEO Sarandos cited lack of hit shows and declining US watch time. Internal memo flagged slipping user engagement, stalling US additions, and missed gaming targets. Stock down 0.3% pre-market; Hedgeye Risk Range keeps NFLX in bearish trend. Consensus expects EPS $0.82 on $12.87B revenue (reporting tonight AH).

bullets.title: META: Tonight's earnings are the AI infrastructure narrative stress test
bullets.body: META reports tonight AH (consensus EPS $6.60, revenue $63.34B); the 2027 capex guide ($190-200B per estimates) is the pivotal number for the AI infrastructure trade. Implied move priced at 6%, though Jefferies notes this feels tight given crowding. JPM frames META/NVDA GTC Berlin as the key tests of AI revenue delivery; Hedgeye Risk Range keeps META in bullish trend.

bullets.title: ORCL: JPM expects FY30 raise at 10/28 AI World event; Citi also constructive
bullets.body: JPM expects Oracle to raise FY30 revenue target above $225B, with FY27 revenue target lifted to at least $90B (from $85B) and FY27 PF EPS guidance to $8.10; multi-cloud database revenue grew +353% Y/Y in F1Q27. Citi echoes the setup positively — Oracle added $200B+ net RPO over LTM with ~50% converting in three years — and sees room for management to raise long-term targets. Both firms flag power/permitting/utility interconnection as execution risks.

bullets.title: NOW: JPM bullish on 3Q beat; ~20% cRPO growth, AI ACV on track for $1.5B
bullets.body: JPM partner checks point to ~20% ServiceNow business expansion among Elite partners, translating to ~200 bps cRPO beat and low-20% reported growth. AI ACV on track to exceed $1.5B target with 10-25% deal size expansion at renewal; consumption monetization remains a 2027 driver. Stock up ~58% since last earnings; organic cRPO stabilization needed to support further re-rating. JPM reiterates Overweight with $150 PT.

bullets.title: SPOT: MS reiterates OW $640 PT; 3Q GM expected 32.9% vs 33.9% guide
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight on SPOT with $640 PT (rolled to YE27, +25% upside), forecasting +5M Premium net adds in 3Q and 33.5% GM in 4Q. Jefferies also favorable on peaking opex growth and AI product launch, though 3Q gross margin expected at 33.1% vs management's 33.9% guide. Spotify Partner Program expanding to 35 new markets; audiobooks going global expected to drive price increases ~6 months post-launch. SPOT reports Oct 22 BM (consensus EPS €2.80, revenue €4.98B).

bullets.title: AMZN: Hedgeye flips to bullish trend; AWS compute sold out through 2028
bullets.body: Hedgeye upgraded AMZN from Bearish to Bullish on its Risk Range signals. Opco notes AWS AI compute sold out through 2028, confirmed by Andy Jassy. UBS flags AWS is spending ~$5B/month on NVDA GB300 deliveries with capex taking FCF negative. Anthropic offering Blackstone >10% yield on $60B chip financing (Project North Star) vs 8.5% prior — signaling rising investor caution on AI credit.

bullets.title: AAPL: Loop downgrades to Hold ($330 PT); UBS Neutral at $296 into FQ4
bullets.body: Loop Capital downgraded AAPL to Hold from Buy, cutting PT to $330 from $370 on continued iPhone shipment reductions. UBS maintains Neutral at $296; FQ4 expects iPhone revenue $56.0B (~14% YoY, decelerating from 22-23%), total revenue $112.8B, Services +~10% YoY, gross margin 47.5% (including 100 bps tariff refund benefit). UK CMA also consulting on proposals to mandate Apple unlock contactless technology access.

bullets.title: CRWV: Bear/bull divide widens; Hedgeye short, others see neocloud stress but not thesis break
bullets.body: CRWV down 67% from summer 2025 peak; Hedgeye labels it core short in 'AI Bubble Prison,' noting 101M share volume vs 31M average with no conviction price action. JPM international desk notes CRWV debt repriced to ~15% yield with 25% market cap loss; bank SPV exposure (~$24B) well-secured vs parent unsecured (~$21B). Jefferies flags CRWV signing 3-6 month deals at $40M/MW vs $12-15M/MW on longer contracts with 9-12 month go-live runway — funding stress rising but thesis not yet broken.

bullets.title: WDC/STX: MS top picks at ~8x FY28 P/E; HDD fundamentals strengthening into prints
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley analyst argues HDD stocks at ~8x FY28 P/E implies the market is pricing cycle peak and 80% SSD price decline — a bar the analyst sees as too pessimistic given strengthening demand, broadening customer base, and accelerating pricing. STX PT raised to $1,200; WDC PT trimmed to $643 from $676 but both reiterated as Top Picks with 10%+ above Street December-quarter EPS forecasts. WDC consensus EPS $4.09 on $4.14B revenue (Oct 22 AH); STX EPS $7.41 on $4.14B (Oct 27 AH).

bullets.title: MU: Indium Corp investment part of $3B domestic supply-chain plan; Taiwan union strike risk
bullets.body: Micron announced investment in critical minerals processing with Indium Corporation (Rome, NY), including a long-term supply agreement for high-purity materials — part of Micron's $3B US supply-chain plan announced in July. Separately, UBS and GS flag Micron's Taiwan union is planning a Thursday strike over a bonus dispute, adding a near-term operational risk.

bullets.title: AVGO: Most undervalued ASIC play as OpenAI TPU demand jumps to 3M units
bullets.body: Jefferies calls AVGO the most undervalued name in the ASIC sector; OpenAI increased TPU demand to 3M units vs prior 1M assumption for 2027. Piper also calls AVGO attractive after earnings given hyperscaler/defensive tech positioning.

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR: Bull case intact — AI infra demand outpaces supply; beat & raise expected Oct 28
bullets.body: Opco reiterates EQIX Outperform ahead of Oct 28 print; expects beat & raise with revenue accelerating to mid-teens from mid-single digits. Tim Horan (Opco) and Jefferies both see hockey-stick growth for EQIX/DLR on AI infrastructure; JV structures address funding/rates concerns. Jefferies notes 30GW of 2028-30 forecast (34%) sits in TX, GA, OH with political risk — incumbents DLR and EQIX advantaged by decades of local community experience vs. new entrants.

bullets.title: SNOW: CoCo (Copilot) could lift consumption 10-30%; AI moat in governed data layer
bullets.body: Jefferies expert calls conclude SNOW's Copilot could accelerate consumption 10-30% via faster builds and incremental agent compute. AI moat sits in the governed data/context layer with steep switching costs; pipeline healthy but not yet inflecting. Jefferies flags DDOG up 82% YTD with largest customer stepping down in Q3 and prefers SNOW on AI infrastructure positioning.

bullets.title: RDDT: Q3 revenue ~$935M expected; +0.2M q/q US DAU sufficient threshold
bullets.body: Jefferies expects RDDT Q3 revenue ~$935M vs $860-870M guide, with Q4 guide ~$1.08B vs Street $1.05B. Street views +0.2M q/q US DAU growth as the sufficient bar; ad checks point to a beat but DAU declines could overshadow. Jefferies notes RDDT as a position where ad momentum is the bull case but DAU trajectory is the swing factor.

bullets.title: VRT: Roth Buy $335 PT; data center demand robust despite October selloff
bullets.body: Roth reiterates VRT Buy with $335 PT, noting Q3 execution is critical but underlying data center demand remains robust; raised 2027 estimates on demand growth and operating leverage. PT reflects impact of higher rates and lower multiples. VRT reports this week.

bullets.title: NBIS/IREN/WULF: Crypto-neocloud complex down 4-5% pre-market on Elice contagion
bullets.body: Korean neocloud Elice crashed 32% on IPO debut (worst Korean IPO for deals $100M+), triggering sector-wide selling: NBIS, IREN, WULF down 4.0-4.6% pre-market. Hedgeye flags 80% of 35 AI stocks now in bearish TREND; WULF specifically highlighted by MS as a conviction long at odds with stock decline given positive contract value and credit support catalysts.

bullets.title: DKNG: JPM cuts PT $3; Q3 EBITDA -$83M low conviction; iGaming decelerating
bullets.body: JPMorgan lowered DKNG year-end 2027 PT by $3 as part of broad gaming cuts. Q3 iGaming growth decelerating (13% vs 16% in Q2, 19% in Q1); OSB handle +8% Y/Y driven by strong July (+32%) offset by August -7% and flat September. Hedgeye also flags DKNG facing Q3 miss on weaker handle growth. Q3 EBITDA estimate -$83M with low conviction; FY27 guidance and PM spend update are the key metrics to watch.
